rows.label: tlk70000029_04_msg0001
rows.name:
If I remember correctly, it's been
decades since someone born outside
Iira was granted a knighthood.

rows.label: tlk70000029_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Of course, that's also proof that Iira
has been peaceful...

rows.label: tlk70000029_04_msg0003
rows.name:
In any case, wonderful news! It's like
Ornella has returned! I haven't felt
this cheerful in a long time!
